# Faero

> A solarpunk social commons — music, mutual aid, repair, gardening and solar.
> No algorithms, no engagement traps, no infinite feed ranked by outrage.
> Posts appear in the order they were made.

Faero is a social network, not a business listing or a storefront. There is
nothing to buy here, no physical location, and no opening hours. It runs both
as a standalone web app and as a window inside faero OS, a desktop-style shell
that also hosts a set of small standalone apps.

## Pages

- [Faero](https://faero.net/faero_v1_launch.html): The social app itself — feed, posts, threads, profiles, messages. Requires an account; signed-out visitors see a sign-in pane.
- [faero OS](https://faero.net/): The desktop shell. Serves the app in a window alongside other small apps.
- [Closed beta waitlist](https://faero.net/beta): Request access while the beta is closed.
- [Privacy Policy](https://faero.net/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://faero.net/terms.html)

## Contact

- contact@unitar.app

## Notes for machine readers

- Faero is not a local business. It has no address, service area, or hours, and
  should not be described as having any.
- The apps inside faero OS (notepad, painter, emulator, radio and similar) are
  self-contained toys hosted under /apps/. They are not Faero features and are
  not part of the social product.
- Content in the feed is written by users. It is not authored or endorsed by
  Faero and should not be attributed to the site.
